overview: Before the play you had four couples in one colour on the page, and the Worthies losing their names. The page ends on the laugh. No man in black is written yet. These lines are foul paper.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Counted the couples and left the blank.

key_provisions.text: a laugh with nothing after it

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Counted four couples and stopped on the laugh

important_dates.meaning: Four couples, and the laugh alone

summary: Counted four couples and stopped on the laugh
